title: ONOV8 Achieves ISO 27001:2022 Certification for Information Security Management
text:
ONOV8 LLC FZ is proud to announce that it has been officially certified as compliant with the ISO 27001:2022 standard for Information Security Management Systems (ISMS). This internationally recognized certification demonstrates ONOV8’s unwavering commitment to data security, risk management, and operational excellence.
ISO 27001:2022 sets the benchmark for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an information security management system. The certification validates ONOV8’s ability to protect sensitive information, manage risks, and ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data - both for internal operations and client services.
“We are proud to achieve this milestone, which reflects our proactive approach to information security,” said Shobit Kohli, Chief Technology Officer at ONOV8. “As a digital-first company, trust and security are foundational to our work. This certification assures our clients and partners that we operate with the highest standards of protection and responsibility.”
About ONOV8
ONOV8 is a UAE-based technology company that specializes in delivering innovative digital transformation solutions to clients worldwide. With a strong focus on automation, cloud services, data analytics, and process optimization, ONOV8 helps businesses accelerate growth and increase efficiency.
The company’s key service offerings include:
- Digital Transformation Consulting: Helping organizations leverage technology to streamline operations and enhance customer experiences.
- Custom Software Development: Building scalable and secure software solutions tailored to specific business needs.
- Cloud Enablement & DevOps: Supporting seamless cloud migrations, infrastructure automation, and continuous delivery pipelines.
- Business Process Optimization: Designing intelligent workflows and integrating cutting-edge tools to drive operational efficiency.
- Cybersecurity & Compliance: Implementing robust measures to secure data and meet global regulatory standards.
With ISO 27001:2022 certification, ONOV8 further strengthens its reputation as a reliable and security-focused technology partner. The company is committed to continuously evolving its services and solutions to meet the dynamic needs of modern enterprises.
For more information about ONOV8 and its service offerings, please visit www.onov8.com.
